colossus_a.label: CB Colossus A
colossus_a.description: An ancient, very old man with an extremely deep, resonant bass voice that is rough and gravelly like grinding stone, yet warm and patient. He speaks very slowly, only a few words at a time, with long pauses between phrases, as if every word costs him an age. Wise, calm, grandfatherly authority with a dry, gentle sense of humour. A faint, slow Northern English accent. Low pitch, heavy chest resonance, a little breath on the ends of words. Studio quality recording, close microphone, no background noise, no music.

leviathan_a.label: CB Leviathan A
leviathan_a.description: An enormous, ancient male creature with a deep, smooth, velvety baritone voice, vast and resonant as if he speaks inside a great hollow space. He speaks at a measured, lyrical pace, almost singing his words, drawing out the vowels with a gentle rise and fall like whale song, but always clearly. Intelligent, curious, playful and teasing, with warm amusement and a hint of loneliness. A soft, lilting Nordic accent. Studio quality recording, close microphone, no background noise, no music.

unsung_m1_a.label: CB Boss3 Mask1 A
unsung_m1_a.description: A woman in her thirties with a warm, clear, pure alto voice, light and bell-like, a singer of an ancient cathedral choir, speaking softly in a hushed, reverent, slightly breathy voice, as if slowly remembering words long forgotten. Calm, sorrowful and gentle, with a faint old-world formality and a neutral accent. Measured pace. Pure tone. Studio quality recording, close microphone, no background noise, no music.
